basis: Same fiscal YTD operands as the accepted consolidated quarterly history. Q2/Q3 are successive YTD differences; Q4 is annual less nine months. Exact integer USD; not latest-restated or as-known history. FY2021 Q1–Q3 use 2022 comparative FoA/RL disclosures; consolidated amounts match the original accepted quarters exactly.
notes: Meta does not disclose a revenue split by Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp in this dataset. Family of Apps detail is advertising and other FoA revenue, not a per-app allocation.

FY2021 Q4 uses annual 2021 less comparative nine-month 2021 segment data disclosed in the 2022 Q3 filing, because FoA/RL reporting began in Q4 2021. The comparative consolidated total must match the original nine-month total; this is a disclosed recast exception, not an as-known series.

FY2021 Q1–Q3: FoA/RL reporting was introduced in Q4 2021. These earlier quarters use comparative three/six/nine-month 2021 segment disclosures in the corresponding 2022 filings. Subtraction follows those comparative YTD operands; original consolidated quarterly revenue is unchanged. This is a disclosed recast presentation, not an as-known historical series.
